Verified against `ea8b12a8a9894b5259c441eadd8f6f0c65e215af`. Checkout unchanged. All ranges are 1-based and inclusive. `D` = declaration, `U` = use, `I` = implementation. “Inherit” means expand the referenced ranges under the parent node and deduplicate overlapping lines.

**d1 n1 — [subsystem, relationship, behavior]**  
Inherit d1 n2–n48; the whole diagram is in scope. Independent end-to-end anchors: `src/main_ghostty.zig:99–115` (UI/core startup and loop, UI); `src/apprt/embedded.zig:1703–1728` (library startup, DUI); `src/Surface.zig:1–16` (session/host boundary, D), `477–827` (full session assembly, including the renderer, I/O, borrowed hosts and worker startup, DUI); `src/termio/Termio.zig:703–762` (PTY output → locked emulation → renderer wake and reply notification, DUI); `src/renderer/generic.zig:1371–1375,1420–1427` (renderer consumes the shared state under the demand lock, DU).

**d1 n2 — [entity, structure, relationship, behavior]**  
`src/App.zig:1–4` D; `22–74` D; `76–159` DUI; `161–331` DUI (tick, configuration fanout, surface registry, quit checks, dispatch, runtime window handoff); `333–529` DUI (app focus, keybindings, theme changes, app actions and broadcast to surfaces); `531–613` DUI (checked delivery, ID lookup, messages and mailbox). Inherit n3–n8, with external code limited to the registry, mailbox, shared-resource and shutdown paths. Startup callers: `src/main_ghostty.zig:99–115` UI; `src/apprt/embedded.zig:1703–1728,1743–1748` UI.

**d1 n3 — [structure, relationship, behavior, guarantee]**  
- `src/App.zig:22–28,45–47` D; `199–260,313–316,544–550` DUI (register/remove hosts, clear focus on removal to prevent address reuse from validating stale focus, check membership on set and get).
- `src/Surface.zig:3466–3473` UI; `src/apprt/surface.zig:227–249` U (checked focus used to inherit working directory).
- `src/apprt/gtk/Surface.zig:25–34` DUI; `src/apprt/gtk/class/surface.zig:779–787,1963–1981,3557–3570` UI.
- `src/apprt/embedded.zig:518–520,634–646,670–676` UI.

**d1 n4 — [structure, behavior, relationship, subsystem]**  
- `src/App.zig:49–51` D; `119–134` UI; `562–613` DUI (message variants, capacity, push and wakeup); `164–167,273–306,532–542` DUI (consumption and dispatch).
- `src/datastruct/blocking_queue.zig:29–72` D; `99–168,203–207` DUI (bounded push and wait/fail policy, nonblocking pop, producer notification).
- `src/Surface.zig:572–588,711–721,887–893` UI; `src/apprt/surface.zig:186–207` DUI (wrap per-surface payload in app message).
- Producer examples: `src/termio/Exec.zig:274–294` UI; `src/termio/stream_handler.zig:138–149` DUI; `src/renderer/generic.zig:1740–1752,2049–2060` UI.
- Runtime wake/receive: `src/apprt/gtk/App.zig:56–59`; `src/apprt/gtk/class/application.zig:569–576,1322–1325`; `src/apprt/embedded.zig:269–271,1730–1736`; `macos/Sources/Ghostty/Ghostty.App.swift:58–62,119–122,526–534` (all UI).

**d1 n5 — [entity, behavior, relationship, guarantee]**  
`src/App.zig:161–167,272–306,531–550` DUI (the intermediate `surfaceMessage` checks `hasSurface` before dispatch); `src/Surface.zig:1015–1241` DUI (full `handleMessage`). Entry points: `src/apprt/gtk/class/application.zig:569–576`, `src/apprt/embedded.zig:1730–1736` UI. Producer-side wrapping and wake: `src/apprt/surface.zig:186–207`, `src/App.zig:596–613` DUI.

**d1 n6 — [structure, relationship, behavior, guarantee]**  
- `src/App.zig:53–55` D; `119–134,141–146` UI.
- `src/font/SharedGridSet.zig:1–10,35–50` D; `52–154,411–452` DUI (initialize, own, count, retain/reuse by configuration, and destroy/remove on final release); `468–472,560–588` D; `736–765` DUI (key hashing inputs). `src/font/SharedGrid.zig:41–64` D; `83–128` DUI (the actual grid caches, atlases and resolver lifetime).
- `src/Surface.zig:528–534,580–588,627–630,870–871,2533–2572` UI (initial acquisition, borrowing, active key, final release, replacement); `src/apprt/gtk/class/surface.zig:2212–2222` UI (temporary acquisition for size estimation).
- `src/renderer/Options.zig:14–15`, `src/renderer/message.zig:29–43` D; `src/renderer/Thread.zig:397–400` UI; `src/renderer/generic.zig:204–207` D, `818–821,1314–1358` UI (adopt new grid before releasing old reference).

**d1 n7 — [structure, relationship, behavior]**  
- `src/App.zig:57–58` D; `126–134,148–151` UI; `src/Surface.zig:564–589` UI (query runtime options and create lazily, otherwise reuse; pass pointer); `src/renderer/Options.zig:7–9` D; `src/renderer.zig:35–45` DUI; `src/renderer/generic.zig:712–721,865–874` UI.
- Device options: `src/apprt/embedded.zig:1253–1257`, `src/apprt/gtk/Surface.zig:107–109`, `src/apprt/gtk/class/surface.zig:1782–1805` DUI.
- Metal: `src/renderer/Metal.zig:20,44–48` D; `56–71,131–146` DUI (per-renderer queue, borrowed device); `src/renderer/metal/Device.zig:17–66,106–136` DUI (app wrapper retains and releases selected `MTLDevice`).
- OpenGL: `src/renderer/OpenGL.zig:15,47–50` D; `52–96` DUI (per-renderer context built from shared device); `src/renderer/opengl/Device.zig:18–74,102–105` DUI. App ownership applies to the OpenGL `Device` wrapper, not to the externally managed EGL display inside it.

**d1 n8 — [entity, behavior, relationship, guarantee]**  
`src/App.zig:136–159` DUI (full `deinit` and `destroy`: runtime cleanup calls, registry release, zero-grid assertion and set teardown, optional device teardown last). `src/apprt/embedded.zig:634–646,1743–1748` DUI (runtime hook deinitializes core surface). `src/main_ghostty.zig:99–115`, `src/apprt/gtk/class/application.zig:663–689`, `src/apprt/gtk/class/surface.zig:1963–1981` UI (GTK destroys windows and finalizes surfaces through the GObject lifecycle); `src/apprt/gtk/Surface.zig:15–17` DI (GTK runtime `Surface.deinit` hook itself is a no-op). `src/Surface.zig:829–879` DUI (joins and releases shared-resource users); `src/font/SharedGridSet.zig:64–86,413–431`, `src/renderer/metal/Device.zig:63–66`, `src/renderer/opengl/Device.zig:102–105` DUI (release endpoints).

**d1 n9 — [structure, entity, relationship, subsystem]**  
`src/apprt.zig:1–10` D, `39–53` DUI (compile-time runtime selection and alias); `src/apprt/gtk.zig:1–4` D; `src/apprt/gtk/Surface.zig:1–39` DUI; `src/apprt/gtk/class/surface.zig:50–57,657–670` D, `779–787,1810–1826,3557–3578,3610–3647,1963–1981` UI (widget owns runtime wrapper and allocated core; creates, stores and destroys it). `src/apprt/embedded.zig:447–459` D, `277–294,504–524,615–646,670–685,1841–1861` DUI (runtime allocation and registration of a host with an inline core, accessor and lifecycle API). `src/Surface.zig:1–12,74–79` D, `477–484,623–626,881–885` UI (core side of host relationship). `src/apprt/none.zig:19` D (empty stub); `src/apprt/browser.zig:1–4` D (browser module is skeletal here, not a concrete surface host). Inherit n10 and the host-side handoffs from n43, not the core terminal/renderer internals.

**d1 n10 — [behavior, relationship, subsystem]**  
- Core delegates host form: `src/Surface.zig:1–12` D; `src/apprt/surface.zig:209–249` DUI (window/tab/split context with inherited settings); `src/Surface.zig:4941–4950,5450–5454,5494–5507`; `src/App.zig:318–331` UI (creation actions delegated to runtime).
- GTK host construction: `src/apprt/gtk/App.zig:61–68` DUI; `src/apprt/gtk/class/application.zig:692–698,739–750,2535–2650` DUI; `src/apprt/gtk/class/window.zig:307–328,426–515` DUI; `src/apprt/gtk/class/tab.zig:185–223` DUI; `src/apprt/gtk/class/split_tree.zig:187–201,203–277,604–639,713–742` DUI. Window creates first tab; tab owns split tree; a split inserts a surface widget.
- GTK event delivery: `src/apprt/gtk/ui/1.0/surface.blp:23–33,43–51,65–74,300–306` DI; `src/apprt/gtk/class/surface.zig:3957–3965,3971–3979` UI (callback binding); same file `1275–1286,1445–1458,2844–2891,2912–2921,2923–2974,3000–3034,3400–3420,3480–3489,3497–3551` UI (key, focus, button, IME text, visibility and size delivery). GTK sends committed IME text via `keyCallback`, not the raw-text API.
- Embedded/macOS host construction: `src/apprt/embedded.zig:301–323,1841–1857` DUI; `macos/Sources/Ghostty/Ghostty.App.swift:58–62,583–595,924–1011` UI; `macos/Sources/App/AppDelegate.swift:301–310,798–816` UI; `macos/Sources/Features/Terminal/TerminalController.swift:64–79,249–339,419–552` DUI; `macos/Sources/Features/Terminal/BaseTerminalController.swift:142–154,189–193,280–316,666–688` DUI; `macos/Sources/Ghostty/Surface View/SurfaceView_AppKit.swift:386–395` UI. “Pane” describes an allowed embedding, not a fourth creation-action variant; see `macos/Sources/Ghostty/Surface View/SurfaceView.swift:541–550` D.
- Embedded/macOS event delivery: `macos/Sources/Ghostty/Surface View/SurfaceView_AppKit.swift:457–458,482–507,922–942,1494–1514,2259–2271` UI; `src/apprt/embedded.zig:202–228,1026–1043,1052–1062,1131–1136,1170–1182,1994–1998,2041–2049,2073–2084,2110–2116,2150–2164` UI. Core receipt anchors: `src/Surface.zig:2600,2792–2795,3426–3437,3466,3918–3923` D; use full callback ranges from n16/n20 where their bodies are in scope.

**d1 n43 — supplemental host-side ranges [behavior, relationship]**  
- Core request: `src/Surface.zig:881–885,993–1013` DUI; `src/App.zig:308–311` UI (checked app-level close).
- GTK: `src/apprt/gtk/Surface.zig:36–39`; `src/apprt/gtk/class/surface.zig:1517–1524,1963–1981,4045–4047`; `src/apprt/gtk/class/split_tree.zig:497–508,604–639,786–871`; `src/datastruct/split_tree.zig:128–142,1322–1329` (UI). GTK rechecks confirmation in the split-tree close handler, removes the leaf, and destroys the core at widget finalization.
- Embedded/macOS: `src/apprt/embedded.zig:98–99` D, `291–294,634–646,678–685,1859–1861` UI; `macos/Sources/Ghostty/Ghostty.App.swift:79,291–296`; `macos/Sources/Features/Terminal/BaseTerminalController.swift:183–188,458–495,518–583,658–664,1231–1256`; `macos/Sources/Features/Terminal/TerminalController.swift:695–755,848–870`; `macos/Sources/Ghostty/Surface View/SurfaceView_AppKit.swift:177–185,386–395`; `macos/Sources/Ghostty/Ghostty.Surface.swift:23–45` (UI). The request can be declined or unsupported; deinit occurs on actual host release, not synchronously on every close request. The macOS undo path may retain the prior tree.
